dispatch_allowance.note: a lost response is still a send; the guard counts it and so does this

internal_held_units.note: free = authorized minus consumed minus children's authorization

lost_responses.note: receipts with no success and no token usage; the provider may or may not have answered and billed.

provider_billing.note: every settled gateway receipt carries billed=null and charge_units=null, so the token counts are known and the charge is not. This is not zero.

reservation_allowance.cost_currencies_note: cost_currencies sizes the study's own shape of six campaigns plus two extra arms, which is not the shape this run subdivides; its number is carried beside this one rather than in place of it
reservation_allowance.source: s09_cap_sheet unit allowance times (_arms_run() + _v1_use_arms() - 1). _arms_run() is the count of children this run creates: one campaign and one use phase per acquisition, and one for the control.

supersedes: cost_currencies reports provider_billing as NOT_REPORTED with the recording-double reason, which is the wrong label for a live run. The four measured numbers are here.
